scope: Reserved-population endpoint smoothing and joint internal-offset atoms

public_exports.name: RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.endpointSmoothing
public_exports.type:
{k n d : ℕ} →
  (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n d) →
    0 < n →
      (c₀ : ℤ) →
        (R : Finset (Fin n)) →
          {g χ : ℝ} →
            {y z v x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k d} →
              RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.Reserve R g →
                RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.GenuineBoundaryPair cuts R χ y z v →
                  RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.IsPrefix v x →
                    RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.EndpointSmoothingData cuts c₀ R x g (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.sideScale cuts R v)
                      (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.varianceDenominator χ v)

public_exports.name: RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.endpointShiftHypergeometric
public_exports.type:
∀ {k n d : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n d) (hn : 0 < n) (c₀ : ℤ) (R : Finset (Fin n)) {g χ : ℝ}
  {y z v x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k d} (hg : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.Reserve R g)
  (h : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.GenuineBoundaryPair cuts R χ y z v) (hvx : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.IsPrefix v x)
  (ω₀ : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) (f : ℤ → ℝ),
  have data := RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.endpointSmoothing cuts hn c₀ R hg h hvx;
  ((RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
        (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => f (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.lowerEndpoint c₀ R x ω))
        fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => data.history ω = data.history ω₀) =
      RiffleUpperV2.expect (data.params ω₀).law.toPMF fun (q : Fin ((data.params ω₀).draws + 1)) =>
        f (data.shift ω₀ + ↑↑q)) ∧
    (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
        (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => f (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.upperEndpoint c₀ R x ω))
        fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => data.history ω = data.history ω₀) =
      RiffleUpperV2.expect (data.params ω₀).law.toPMF fun (q : Fin ((data.params ω₀).draws + 1)) =>
        f (data.shift ω₀ + ↑↑q + ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.prefixRows R x ω₀).card)

public_exports.name: RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.smoothingFailure
public_exports.type:
∀ {k n d : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n d) (hn : 0 < n) (c₀ : ℤ) (R : Finset (Fin n)) {g χ : ℝ}
  {y z v x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k d} (hg : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.Reserve R g)
  (h : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.GenuineBoundaryPair cuts R χ y z v) (hvx : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.IsPrefix v x),
  (RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      ¬(RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.endpointSmoothing cuts hn c₀ R hg h hvx).good ω) ≤
    3 * Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * g * RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.sideScale cuts R v)

public_exports.name: RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.endpointVariance
public_exports.type:
∀ {k n d : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n d) (hn : 0 < n) (c₀ : ℤ) (R : Finset (Fin n)) {g χ : ℝ}
  {y z v x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k d} (hg : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.Reserve R g)
  (h : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.GenuineBoundaryPair cuts R χ y z v) (hvx : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.IsPrefix v x)
  (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
  (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.endpointSmoothing cuts hn c₀ R hg h hvx).good ω →
    g * RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.sideScale cuts R v / (16 * RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.varianceDenominator χ v) ≤
      ((RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.endpointSmoothing cuts hn c₀ R hg h hvx).params ω).varianceFormula

public_exports.name: RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.conditionalEndpointAtoms
public_exports.type:
∀ {k n d : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n d) (hn : 2 ≤ n),
  1 ≤ d →
    ∀ (c₀ : ℤ) (R : Finset (Fin n)) {g χ : ℝ} {y z v x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k d}
      (hg : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.Reserve R g) (h : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.GenuineBoundaryPair cuts R χ y z v)
      (hvx : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.IsPrefix v x) (u : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.InternalHistory k n d),
      (0 <
          RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
            RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x ω = u) →
        ∀ (rank : ℤ),
          have data := RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.endpointSmoothing cuts ⋯ c₀ R hg h hvx;
          (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                  RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.lowerEndpoint c₀ R x ω = rank ∧ data.good ω)
                fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x ω = u) ≤
              16 * √(RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.varianceDenominator χ v / (g * RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.sideScale cuts R v)) ∧
            (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                  RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.upperEndpoint c₀ R x ω = rank ∧ data.good ω)
                fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x ω = u) ≤
              16 * √(RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.varianceDenominator χ v / (g * RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.sideScale cuts R v))

public_exports.name: RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.jointInternalOffsetAtoms
public_exports.type:
∀ {k n d : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n d) (hn : 2 ≤ n),
  1 ≤ d →
    ∀ (c₀ : ℤ) (R : Finset (Fin n)) {g χ : ℝ} {y z v x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k d}
      (hg : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.Reserve R g) (h : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.GenuineBoundaryPair cuts R χ y z v)
      (hvx : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.IsPrefix v x) (offset : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.InternalHistory k n d → ℤ)
      (H : RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.InternalHistory k n d → Prop) (rank : ℤ),
      have data := RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.endpointSmoothing cuts ⋯ c₀ R hg h hvx;
      ((RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
            RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.lowerEndpoint c₀ R x ω + offset (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x ω) = rank ∧
              data.good ω ∧ H (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x ω)) ≤
          16 * √(RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.varianceDenominator χ v / (g * RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.sideScale cuts R v)) *
            RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
              H (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x ω)) ∧
        (RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
            RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.upperEndpoint c₀ R x ω + offset (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x ω) = rank ∧
              data.good ω ∧ H (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x ω)) ≤
          16 * √(RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.varianceDenominator χ v / (g * RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.sideScale cuts R v)) *
            RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
              H (RiffleUpperV2.Anchor.internalHistory R x ω)
